steps.what: Update knowledge from recent computer technology notes.
Attend a seminar on computer technology advancements.
File the skills note after the seminar.
Ask a colleague which advancement matters on this board.

tasks.design: The seminar and the reading stay with the computer hardware engineer. A skills note on {DOCS} keeps what they decided to remember, so the next project does not start from a pile of unmarked files. A colleague still says which advancement matters for this board.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes lived in personal files and the useful point was easy to lose.
tasks.enabler_now: A shared note can be filed. Judging which advancement matters is still the reading.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which new part is real and which is a pitch.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer has seen which change broke a previous board.
tasks.altitude: Reading and seminars stay. The filed note is shorter to find next time. Nothing about what to learn is handed off.

reach.task: Keep a current note on component limits they actually use
reach.learn: Which announcements they treat as noise

evidence.claim: Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from a new note or seminar to a filed skills note. Designing the board is out of scope.
Fields are topic, source title, date and one sentence on why it matters. The engineer writes them. Fallback: the note stays a free-text file.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 1.2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the topic list on the note.
unknowns: Whether the team already has a shared reading list.
Which seminars are worth the afternoon.
research_questions: What share of reading is a vendor pitch?
How often is the skills note opened on the next project?

incremental.description: Keep the topic list on the skills note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each seminar is new and the note is rewritten by hand. High case: only the filing is shorter, and the reading and the seminar stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read requirements before hardware design starts.
Design central processing units and support logic.
Sketch printers, disk drives and support peripherals.
Review the hardware design with a colleague.

tasks.design: Requirements sit as fields on {DOCS} so the computer hardware engineer does not retype them into the drawing. The design of processors, support logic, custom circuits, printers and disk drives stays on the drawing tool, and a colleague still reviews it in the room. No model proposes the architecture.
tasks.previous_blocker: Constraints were copied by hand into the drawing at the start of each project.
tasks.enabler_now: A field list can be reused. The architecture is still drawn by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a structure that meets timing, power and cost together.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which constraint will break the board later.
tasks.altitude: Design time barely moves. The engineer still owns the drawing and the review. Finding the written requirements is shorter.

reach.task: Fit a board and its drives into a chassis
reach.learn: Which mechanical limit arrives after the logic is already drawn

evidence.claim: Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.
The engineer who signs stays responsible for the design.
Under the EU AI Act, safety components in road traffic, water, gas, heating or electricity are high-risk from 2 December 2027. An ordinary office computer is not automatically on that list.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from agreed product requirements to a reviewed hardware design. Issuing a controlled specification is a later task.
Fields are requirement id, limit, unit and source. The product owner writes them. Fallback: the engineer types a missing limit and marks it manual.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the requirement field list.
unknowns: Whether designs are already in a controlled drawing store.
Whether this hardware is a safety component of machinery or of energy supply.
research_questions: How often does a design start with a missing limit?
How much of the week is the drawing itself?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: almost every board is a new architecture, so the drawing stays fully manual. High case: only the requirement copy shrinks. The design itself stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate the hardware and software interface.

steps.what: Consult specifications for the hardware and software interface.
Confer with engineering staff about the interface.
Evaluate operational and performance requirements of the system.
File the interface note for the engineering staff.

loop.input: The evaluation and the interface extract
loop.output: A note that quotes only those points
loop.check: The engineer deletes any limit not in the extract
loop.stop: One draft, then the engineer edits by hand
loop.why_not_simpler: The note is prose around limits, not a new calculation

tasks.design: The interface specification is readable as fields on {DOCS}. The conference with engineering staff stays in the room, and the computer hardware engineer still evaluates operational and performance requirements. A note may only quote limits that are already in the extract.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specification was searched by hand in the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: The extract can be opened before the conference. The evaluation is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a software limit and a hardware limit can both be true.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer hears which requirement the other side will not move.

ambition.what: The engineer decides, before the conference ends, which interface limit is binding.

tasks.altitude: Less time hunting the specification. The conference and the evaluation stay. The engineer can refuse a limit that is not written down.

reach.task: State the electrical limits of a hardware interface
reach.learn: Which limits they will not leave implied

evidence.claim: Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.
Requirements and verification status can be kept as records. That tracking does not choose the part or the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from an existing interface specification to a filed evaluation. Changing the software is out of scope.
Fields are signal name, direction, timing limit, voltage limit and unit. The author of the specification writes them. Fallback: the engineer types a limit read from the drawing and marks it manual.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the signal field list.
unknowns: Whether hardware and software specifications share one record.
Who is allowed to change an interface limit.
research_questions: How often is the specification missing a limit the conference needs?
How often does the conference reopen a limit that was already written?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the specification is incomplete and the conference does the real work. High case: the extract is ready and only the evaluation and the conference remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Set boundary conditions for the computer simulation.
Run the named computer simulation of the prototype.
Build the working product prototype on the bench.
Modify the prototype where the bench test fails.
Record the prototype test against the specification.

tasks.design: The computer hardware engineer sets the boundary conditions, and only then does the solver on the {DATA_PLATFORM} rerun that model. Building and modifying the prototype stays on the bench. The test record on {DOCS} stores the measurement, the limit and the pass or fail, and an unexplained miss is not rewritten by the solver.
tasks.previous_blocker: Simulation setup, the bench and the results lived in separate files.
tasks.enabler_now: A named run can be repeated. The bench build and the modification stay physical work.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing that a simulation and the bench disagree, and deciding which to trust.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which setup the solver quietly assumes.
tasks.altitude: Waiting on a repeat run shrinks. Bench time and the decision to modify the prototype stay.

reach.task: Say whether a bench prototype can be built the same way on the line
reach.learn: Which bench result they cannot reproduce

evidence.claim: A solver can rerun a model once the engineer has set the boundary conditions. An executable run is not a correct design.
The engineer who signs stays responsible for the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from a prototype specification to a bench result recorded against that specification. Releasing a test report outside the team is out of scope.
Fields are measurement name, value, unit, limit, pass or fail, tester and date. The engineer writes the limit and the result. Fallback: the row is typed from the instrument.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the measurement list and the stored boundary set.
unknowns: Whether the solver already runs unattended today.
Which prototypes have no trustworthy past run.
research_questions: How often does the bench contradict the simulation?
How much time is waiting on a run versus setting it up?

incremental.description: Maintain measurement names and stored boundary sets

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each prototype is new, so setup and the bench dominate. High case: a repeated run is unattended and only the record is shorter. The build stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Design reviews and the bench stay in the week. Finding a written requirement or a skills note takes less hunting. The engineer still decides the architecture.
reach: Electrical Engineers, on which interface limits are real.
Manufacturing Engineers, on which bench result the line cannot repeat.
skills_to_grow: Naming the constraint that binds before drawing.
Setting a simulation up so a repeat run is meaningful.
role.ambitious_version: The seminar is used on a gap in the current board, and the next design starts from the filed note rather than from memory.
